method: Each definition in s10-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, as envoi_web; merchant accounts are created by the operator functions with passwords generated in memory per run, and their FIXTURE shops are created through the merchant routes. Every SGQR payload is a FIXTURE built tag by tag; none is an authentic sticker. S10 adds no migration; the camera policy unit test reads next.config.ts directly. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.
